# Draft:King Whalay

= King Whalay =
King Whalay born 30th October 1994 is a Nigerian-born, United Kingdom-based music producer and recording artist known for his work in Afrobeats and Afro-fusion. He has received coverage in Nigerian national newspapers and United Kingdom regional press for both his production work and live performances.
Career
Early production work
King Whalay began his career as a music producer and songwriter, contributing to collaborative Afrobeats and Afro-fusion projects. In 2021, he participated in the Crime Free Christmas Campaign, a multi-artist initiative supported by Oyo State Government and aired across Nigerian radio stations.
In September 2021, ThisDay Live reviewed his single “TWIMC (To Whom It May Concern),” describing the project’s socially reflective tone.
In November 2022, ThisDay Live also covered his executive production involvement in the juju-influenced album Experience, noting his blending of traditional Yoruba rhythmic elements with contemporary Afro-fusion.
Transition to recording artist
In October 2025, King Whalay released the extended play S.O.S (Songs of Solomon), recorded in Bradford, United Kingdom.
The EP was reviewed by Independent Nigeria and The Sun Nigeria, which highlighted its blend of Afro-fusion and live instrumentation.
United Kingdom activities
King Whalay has also been covered by UK regional press for performances and community engagement. In 2025, he headlined a music event at the University of Bradford.
He also participated in Black History Month celebrations at Bradford Royal Infirmary.
In January 2024, Vanguard Nigeria profiled him in a feature discussing his cross-border musical activities.
Musical style
Reviews have noted King Whalay’s integration of traditional Yoruba percussion and live instrumentation within contemporary Afro-fusion arrangements.
